changelog: Templates: sample values for every {{n}} are sent to Meta as 'example' (fixes REJECTED – INVALID_FORMAT), with clear errors for gaps or a variable at the start/end.
Forms keep their input after a validation error (old() read the data too early).
Toasts: max 3, hidden after 5s, duplicates merged, click to close, none while the tab is hidden.

Inbox: reaction, sticker, contacts, location, button/list replies, interactive, template, edit, delete and 'unsupported' messages are described; unknown types show 'Unsupported message type: <type>'. Old '[type]' rows are fixed automatically.
Inbox: message bubbles no longer have large empty space.
Typing indicator is shown only to other agents.
WhatsApp page: the reason for an account error (e.g. access token expired) plus a Reconnect button; Refresh clears the error once the token works; platform-owner note about Manual connect.
Expired trial/subscription locks the tenant panel to the Billing page. Super admin and impersonation are never blocked, and webhooks, API and cron keep running.
Inbox: old messages no longer pop up again on page load, no duplicate popups, and realtime stays on SSE after navigation.
PHP 8.5 compatibility: Pdo\Mysql::ATTR_INIT_COMMAND and no more curl_close(). Both were deprecated in 8.5 and broke cron and every Meta API call.
WhatsApp Business app coexistence (QR) onboarding + Embedded Signup fixes (race, popup blocking, CANCEL/ERROR events).
Coexistence webhooks: smb_message_echoes, history, smb_app_state_sync; history/echo media is downloaded when under 14 days old.
Web Cron URL (/cron/run/<key>) for servers without a system cron; Meta webhooks are also processed right after the 200 reply.
Trial-expired / subscription-expired status on the admin tenant list, the tenant dashboard and the billing page.
Manual connect: optional two-step PIN; generated PINs are shown to the tenant; temporary tokens are detected and expiry warnings are scheduled.
Coexistence badge + limitations notice; /admin/system-health redirects to /admin/health.
